title: fumana glutinosa f. juniperina
intro: Fumana glutinosa f. juniperina, commonly known as Juniper-leaf Rockrose, is a plant species within the Cistaceae family. It is a shrub-like perennial with a woody base, known for its medicinal properties and versatility. The health benefits of Juniper-leaf Rockrose include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of wounds, skin irritations, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
